Since both students have the same total mass and ascend the same height, the work done against gravity (\(W = mgh\)) is the same for both. Power is the rate of doing work (\(P = W/t\)). With the same work, the student who takes less time has the greater power output. Mary takes 30 s while Roberta takes 45 s, so Mary has the greater power output.
